responsibility: Defines the primary target macro interface for the rs6000/PowerPC backend. It establishes object-format and ABI configuration macros, assembler and driver spec fragments, default CPU/feature policies, target feature predicates, builtin type and declaration enums and accessors, and numerous compile-time hooks and constants that generated machine descriptions and C sources rely on to configure PowerPC code generation across AIX, ELF, Darwin, SPE, VSX, and related subtargets.
same_name_distinction: This is the main rs6000 target header, defining compile-time macros, enums, specs, and declarations that other files use. Unlike powerpcspe.c, it does not implement backend logic, unlike powerpcspe.md it does not define RTL patterns, and unlike powerpcspe.opt it does not declare option records.
